notes: Continuation of a handwritten letter signed R. Hartshorne. The writer qualifies his opening claim with ‘I believe’ and says the artinian hypothesis in the proposition on p. 38 is unnecessary under the stated AR-J-adic noetherian hypotheses. He gives three exact sequences, invokes inverse limit and Artin–Rees, and claims that the middle system is AR-J-adic. These are the writer's claims, not a proof verified in this reading. Three pale arrows cross the intervening text from the bottom sequence to X, Y and Z; their hand is not established. The closing paragraph names the paper ‘Affine Duality and Cofiniteness’ and promises a copy when ready. The one-word deletion remains unreadable. The marginal pair remains uncertain in function and is reproduced as two oblique points in TikZ. No date or salutation occurs on this leaf. One manuscript page number, 2, appears at top; archive number 54 is at bottom left and is recorded only in a comment. The letter has no separate title; its paper title is quoted in the prose. The author draws no explicit question mark here. H supplies description only, so h_reading is null and diff_h is false throughout; its unrelated trailing cover note was disregarded. All four explicit C doubts were independently inspected and remain unresolved. The main reader refines the marginal pair’s graphic placement; no prose or mathematical word is changed. The raised AR and its hyphen, lower-case let, all primes, alphabets, signs, quote pairs, arrows and punctuation were checked. The pale irregular contour at the left edge of the middle region was assessed as paper staining, not a textual or diagrammatic mark.
math_reading_decisions: The opening X and Z, the first-sequence X/Y/Z, and the hooked J forms have ordinary single strokes. The raised AR belongs before the first -J-adic and is retained as an insertion.
The first exponent n+1 before X is definite. The joined terminal strokes in the later two exponents leave the C n+1 versus n+{} alternative unresolved at its first occurrence, before Y.
Each lower n in the first equality is below the baseline. The final n in (A/J^{n+1})_n lies outside the closing parenthesis.
The limit has a separate continuous left-pointing arrow below lim.
The M terms carry zero, one, and two raised prime strokes as transcribed. The tensor signs have enclosing loops and internal crossing strokes.
The defined system A and the four A symbols paired with tensors have doubled left diagonals and are written as \mathbb{A}. The numerator A in the quotient has an ordinary single diagonal.
The category P has small AR below the baseline. The map to Y has two waves above a separate right-pointing arrow.
All twelve horizontal exact-sequence arrows point right. The three thinner arrows point upward from the bottom sequence to X, Y, and Z, crossing the middle row without terminating there.
The cropped exponent chain does not license completing a missing 1 from the mathematical pattern. Both attached forms retain the same declared uncertainty.
The letter’s inverse-limit exactness, Artin–Rees step and isomorphism conclusion were read, not independently proved, used as established background or checked against another source.
